techniques.name: SaaS promo beat structure
techniques.how: Each 2-4 s beat: headline (blur or slide_up, reveal words step 0.25) + one big UI panel arriving with tilt/zoom/rise + 2-3 chips popping 0.15 s apart. Camera push-in 1.0->1.1 on every beat; hero floats y 10.

techniques.name: Hook question with big number
techniques.how: Beat 1 (0-2.5 s): plain dark bg + blob. One line 'What if just {n} customers': number in accent colour, bigger, count-up; words reveal step 0.2; then blur into a UI panel.

techniques.name: Tilted glass UI panel
techniques.when: showing a dashboard, pricing or app screen
techniques.how: card/device layer yaw -14..-18, scale 1.4, glass border + glow shadow; animate yaw to 0 and scale 1.4->1.5 over 2 s while camera pushes in; blur other panels behind (blur 6, opacity .4).

techniques.name: Typed prompt / search bar
techniques.when: script says search, ask, domain, AI prompt
techniques.how: rrect pill w 900 h 90 glass, search icon left, text reveal chars step 0.05, arrow_up icon pops when typing ends, then the bar slides up and the result panel zooms in.

techniques.name: People joined by lines (community)
techniques.how: 6 circle avatars in a row, a logo chip above, line layers from logo to each avatar (wipe), avatars pop 0.12 s apart, a price label ($49/mo) pops over the first one.

techniques.name: Count-up money card
techniques.how: card kind custom big_text '${n}' with keys number 0->target ease out over 1.8 s, accent header, glow shadow; a green chip '+x%' pops when the count ends; chime.

techniques.name: Two-bar comparison
techniques.when: you keep vs platform cost, before vs after
techniques.how: two progress bars or bar chart: left 'You Keep' 77% grows (grow dur 1.2), right 'Platform cost' 0% stays empty; pill labels above each; accent colour on the winner.

techniques.name: Pricing cards row
techniques.how: 3 cards side by side, middle one scale 1.12 with accent border + 'Best value' chip; rise in 0.15 s apart; then a 'Buy now' rrect pulses (scale 1->1.05 keys) while the camera pushes in.

techniques.name: Phone fan mockup
techniques.how: 3 phone devices fanned (rot -12, 0, 12; centre bigger), app icon chip pops on the centre one; slow float; brand-colour blob behind.

techniques.name: Feature list stagger
techniques.how: Headline left (size 90), 4-5 chips/rrects right, slide_left in 0.2 s apart; each gets an accent border in turn while its line is spoken; others dim to opacity .5.

techniques.name: Sparkle/orb logo sting
techniques.how: big accent circle/icon pops with bounce, glow shadow 60, particles burst, ring scales 1->2 and fades; brand letters rise below; riser sound ends exactly on the pop.

techniques.name: Blur-through scene transition
techniques.how: Old scene ends blur 0->10 + zoom out 0.4 s while the new one starts blur 10->0 zooming in; add a flash transition 0.3 s only on the biggest change (into the logo).

techniques.name: Closing CTA hold
techniques.how: Logo + one line + accent button chip ('Book a demo today') centred, pop in then float y 6; nothing leaves; soft glow behind; shimmer hit + chime on the button.

techniques.name: Script word to visual mapper
techniques.how: Read the script sentence by sentence: pick ONE visual from its key noun (money->count card, people->avatars, app->phone, site->browser, speed->sparkle, list->chips, versus->two bars); time it to that sentence; text 3-6 words.

techniques.name: Evidence board with red string
techniques.when: crime, mystery, investigation, who is behind
techniques.how: polaroid rrects at 5 spots rot +-5, pop 0.18 s apart; then line layers (red, w 4) wipe between pairs 0.25 s apart; flash transition red; final red title with blur-in + glow.

techniques.name: Floor-plan tape lines
techniques.how: off-white line layers w 6 forming open rooms, drawn by wipe (right/down/up); props (cards, chips) sit inside them; camera push 1.06 per scene.

techniques.name: Typewriter dossier card
techniques.how: tan paper rrect slides in from the side (rot 1.5); name bold 74 wipe-in; role italic with chars reveal 0.04; date pills (dark rrect + light bold text) pop last.

techniques.name: Dated history title
techniques.how: huge red month (bold_italic 230, zoom in), yellow-green label rrect rot -1 with year 100 popping under it, two polaroid portraits with name text rot +-7 land after.

techniques.name: Object parade on blue
techniques.how: ocean/blue bg with particles; one emoji/image per idea (210 px) bounces in 0.5 s apart, float y 14 phase offset; a one-line caption by words; fade them all before the next headline.

techniques.name: Cut-out with doodle icons
techniques.how: person image with white outline centred; gear/pie/dollar icons pop with bounce one per idea around the head; slight float; dark paper-texture bg.

techniques.name: Tilt-shift map scene
techniques.how: map image bg blurred top/bottom (vignette), small boat/icon images drifting along an orange dashed line (line layer wipe), red circle ring marking the place; slow camera push.

techniques.name: Paper scene swap
techniques.how: wipe transition (dark colour 0.5 s) at the cut; the new paper card rises (slide up 0.8 s) while old items fade; keep the same polaroid position so the eye stays.

techniques.name: Footer Legal Banner Reveal
techniques.when: Displaying copyright details, terms, or platform metadata at the end of a promotional video
techniques.how: Slide a dark bottom card up into frame. Animate a horizontal accent line using wipe_right across the top edge of the card. Bring in legal and copyright text using blur and fade with a slight delay.

techniques.name: Feature Tag Grid Stagger
techniques.when: Showcasing multiple navigation links, creator tools, or feature categories
techniques.how: Display a subtle background grid. Pop in category chips sequentially across the screen. Animate label text inside each chip using rise and fade.

techniques.name: Service Announcement Spotlight
techniques.when: Introducing a new feature offer or premium service tier
techniques.how: Place a glowing background blob. Zoom in a rounded card frame with a slight tilt entrance. Layer bold headline text with slide_up and a call-to-action chip with bounce.
